question: A charge is placed at the centre of a closed spherical surface. How will the total electric flux and electric field at the surface change if the radius of the sphere is doubled? Justify your answer.

options.A: The total flux becomes one-fourth and the electric field remains unchanged
options.B: Both total flux and electric field become one-fourth of their initial values
options.C: The total flux remains unchanged, while the electric field at the surface becomes one-fourth
options.D: The total flux doubles, while the electric field becomes half
